# inbospatial

The goal of `inbospatial` is to share useful R functions for dealing
with spatial raster or vector data. These functions have mostly been
written as part of scientific projects conducted at the Research
Institute for Nature and Forest. Although the scope of some of these
functions might be pretty niche, others may be relevant to the broader
research community.

## Installation

You can install the development version from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("inbo/inbospatial")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

``` r

# library(inbospatial)
## basic example code
```

# Package index

## Functions for getting or displaying data from web services

- [`add_wms_be_cartoweb()`](https://inbo.github.io/inbospatial/reference/add_wms.md)
  [`add_wms_be_ortho()`](https://inbo.github.io/inbospatial/reference/add_wms.md)
  [`add_wms_nl_ortho()`](https://inbo.github.io/inbospatial/reference/add_wms.md)
  [`add_wms_fl_grbmap()`](https://inbo.github.io/inbospatial/reference/add_wms.md)
  [`add_wms_fl_habitatmap()`](https://inbo.github.io/inbospatial/reference/add_wms.md)
  [`add_wms_fl_habitatlabels()`](https://inbo.github.io/inbospatial/reference/add_wms.md)
  [`add_wms_fl_forestnature()`](https://inbo.github.io/inbospatial/reference/add_wms.md)
  [`add_wms_fl_agriculture()`](https://inbo.github.io/inbospatial/reference/add_wms.md)
  [`add_wms_nlnb_nnb()`](https://inbo.github.io/inbospatial/reference/add_wms.md)
  [`add_wms_nlnb_natte_natuurparels()`](https://inbo.github.io/inbospatial/reference/add_wms.md)
  [`add_wms_nlnb_ambitie_landschapstypen()`](https://inbo.github.io/inbospatial/reference/add_wms.md)
  [`add_wms_nlnb_ambitie_natuurtypen()`](https://inbo.github.io/inbospatial/reference/add_wms.md)
  [`add_wms_nlnb_landschapstypen()`](https://inbo.github.io/inbospatial/reference/add_wms.md)
  [`add_wms_nlnb_natuurtypen()`](https://inbo.github.io/inbospatial/reference/add_wms.md)
  : addWMSTiles() and addWMS() wrapper functions for WMS services
- [`add_wmts_nl_brt()`](https://inbo.github.io/inbospatial/reference/add_wmts.md)
  [`add_wmts_nl_ortho()`](https://inbo.github.io/inbospatial/reference/add_wmts.md)
  : addTiles() wrapper functions for WMTS services
- [`check_ogc_collection()`](https://inbo.github.io/inbospatial/reference/check_ogc_collection.md)
  : Check if a collection exists in an OGC API Features service
- [`get_coverage_wcs()`](https://inbo.github.io/inbospatial/reference/get_coverage_wcs.md)
  : Get a layer from a web coverage service within a bounding box
- [`get_feature_ogc()`](https://inbo.github.io/inbospatial/reference/get_feature_ogc.md)
  : Download features from an OGC API Features service
- [`get_feature_wfs()`](https://inbo.github.io/inbospatial/reference/get_feature_wfs.md)
  : Get a layer from a web feature service
- [`get_wcs_layers()`](https://inbo.github.io/inbospatial/reference/get_wcs_layers.md)
  : Get available layers from a web coverage service

## Functions to explore properties of coordinate reference systems

- [`scalefactor_lcc()`](https://inbo.github.io/inbospatial/reference/scalefactor_lcc.md)
  : Return the scale factor for a specific parallel in a Lambert Conic
  Conformal projection
- [`scalefactor_tcyl()`](https://inbo.github.io/inbospatial/reference/scalefactor_tcyl.md)
  : Return the scale factor for the angular distance from the central
  meridian in an (unscaled) transverse cylindrical projection
